title: The Empty Safe
scene: At 2:30 PM, the bank deposit safe was emptied. The vault elevator was stuck between floors from 2:20 to 2:45.

suspects.name: Clara Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at window three from 2:15 to 2:40, serving customers.
suspects.alibiProof: The window camera shows Clara at 2:18, 2:30 and 2:38.

suspects.name: Desmond Ash
suspects.testimony: I was riding the stuck elevator at 2:30, waiting for help.
suspects.contradiction: The elevator call log shows no ride after 2:18, and the safe dial had Desmond's prints.

suspects.name: Mei Lin
suspects.testimony: I was on the phone with the regional office at 2:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The office record shows Mei's extension connected from 2:22 to 2:41.

suspects.name: Owen Pike
suspects.testimony: I was waiting in the lobby at 2:30 with a sealed bag.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby queue camera shows Owen from 2:25 to 2:42.
